comment: Independent C-first dwarvish Archeologist with symset:IBMgraphics and msg_window:reverse. #name calls the starting kitten by a getlin answer whose first three bytes are 0xEE 0xA4 0x97, then #chat northeast prints a message that begins with that name. Ctrl-P lists the history newest first in a full-width text window: process_text_window()'s `(*cp & 0x80)` arm sends the first byte through g_putch(), whose SYMHANDLING(H_IBM) arm prints it without graph_on(), so recorder patch 006 stores a plain 'n' (0xEE with the high bit stripped) in column 1, and the two ignored bytes after it leave it showing (step 25). Varies the default-symset recipe by g_putch() arm, window order and placement, and role.
